messages:
Maria P: Hey team — packaging for the CloudPartnerX connector is ready for initial QA. Artifacts pushed to https://github.com/redwood/integrations/cloudpartnerx/tree/onboarding. Please skim and flag any blockers.

Devin S: Nice, thanks. What exactly is in the bundle? tf module only or extras?

Samir K: tf module, example app (minimal echo service), Helm chart for the sidecar, and a small `tests/` dir with kitchen-terraform smoke tests. Also added a `Makefile` target `make smoke`.

Laura T: Can we get a short acceptance checklist so we can hand off to Marketplace team? They usually need README, example, semver tag, and registry metadata.

Maria P: Yep — initial checklist I propose:
- README with quickstart and troubleshooting
- at least one example under `examples/` showing dedicated + private deploy
- semver tag (v0.1.0) + github release notes
- CI pipeline: `terraform fmt`, `terraform validate`, `tflint`, `kitchen test` / smoke
- Terraform Registry metadata (providers, compat, maintainers)
- Signed artifacts for Marketplace (image sig + provenance)
- Security questionnaire completed (see partner-security.md)

Samir K: I'll implement the `make smoke` target to run `terraform init && terraform apply -auto-approve` against a tiny test infra and then curl the sample endpoint. Will add a short output assertion so tests fail fast. Also adding matrix CI to spin tests for x86 and arm64.

Devin S: Snippet we can put in README for module usage: ```hcl
module "cloudpartnerx_ref" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/integrations/cloudpartnerx.git?ref=v0.1.0"
  region = var.region
}
```

Laura T: Also: marketplace scanners require clear IAM scope docs. List the minimal SA roles we request so partners can pre-provision. And give fallback publish steps in case automated registry checks fail.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created CI run `cloudpartnerx-smoke-1765432100` triggered by Maria P. Link: https://ci.redwood.dev/teams/partners/jobs/1234 (status: queued)

Marcus (CloudPartnerX): Thanks — we'll run internal validation next Tue. What's the recommended minimal IAM scope for the TF SA? Also who does the security questionnaire?

Maria P: Minimal IAM for the smoke run: `compute.admin` (create small VMs), `storage.admin` (state bucket), `iam.serviceAccounts.get` (if reading SA), and optionally `kms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` only if you opt into encrypted state. I'll cc security.

Leah S: Leah S: Got it — I'll send the vendor security template and a contact checklist. ETA EOD Mon.

Maria P: Perfect. Once CI is green and we tag v0.1.0 I'll move the status to `partner-iac-ready` in our tracker and ping Marketplace to schedule listing. Quick reminder: keep the example infra tiny to avoid partner cloud costs during validation. :thumbsup: :party-parrot:

Devin S: One last ask — can we include a short troubleshooting snippet about common TF plan failures (provider mismatch, missing creds) in README? Saves support time.

Samir K: On it. I'll add a `troubleshooting.md` with two common errors + fixes and link to partner runbook.

Maria P: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with release note draft once tag is created.
